Definition: poured out, i.e. run into a mould
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, yᵉtsuqâh is the word for cast, poured into a mould. In 1 Kings 7:24, the knops were cast in two rows, and it appears again in 1 Kings 7:30.
TheologicalSignificance: Bronze poured into a mould holds its shape, and I believe yᵉtsuqâh pictures how God's house was made to last.
